name: AlAdhan Prayer Times API
description: Dedicated, battle-tested RESTful API offering global prayer times calculations, monthly/yearly calendars, Hijri-to-Gregorian date conversions, Qibla compass bearing, and Asma Al-Husna. Supports lookups by geographic coordinates, city name, or address string with extensive customization options.

authentication.description: Public, keyless API. No token or registration required.

rateLimit.policy: Open access with generous throttling. Client-side caching of prayer timetables for 24 hours is strongly recommended.

calculationMethods.name: Institute of Geophysics, University of Tehran
Spiritual Administration of Muslims of Russia
Algeria (Algerian Ministry of Religious Affairs and Wakfs)
calculationMethods.authority: Algerian Ministry of Religious Affairs and Wakfs
calculationMethods.description: Algerian Ministry of Religious Affairs and Wakfs. Uses standard Fajr angle of 18° and Isha angle of 17°.

calculationMethods.name: Ministry of Awqaf, Islamic Affairs and Holy Places, Jordan

endpoints.name: Timings by Coordinates
endpoints.description: Returns prayer times for a specific date (or current date if omitted or set to today) given geographic coordinates.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Date formatted as DD-MM-YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD or Unix timestamp. Defaults to current date if omitted.

parameters.name: tune
parameters.description: Comma-separated minute offsets for [Imsak, Fajr, Sunrise, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Sunset, Isha, Midnight]

parameters.name: midnightMode
parameters.description: 0 = Standard (Sunset to Sunrise), 1 = Jafari (Sunset to Fajr)

parameters.name: latitudeAdjustmentMethod
parameters.description: 1 = Middle of the Night, 2 = One Seventh, 3 = Angle Based

parameters.name: adjustment
parameters.description: Number of days to adjust Hijri date by (e.g. 1 or -1)

parameters.name: iso8601
parameters.description: Return times formatted in ISO-8601 strings

endpoints.name: Timings by City
endpoints.description: Returns prayer times for a city and country.

endpoints.name: Timings by Address
endpoints.description: Returns prayer times for any free-form string address resolved by geocoding.

endpoints.name: Calendar by Coordinates
endpoints.description: Returns a full month or full year calendar of prayer times based on coordinates.

parameters.name: annual
parameters.description: Set to true to return the whole year

endpoints.name: Calendar by City
endpoints.description: Returns a full month prayer timetable for a given city and country.

endpoints.name: Gregorian to Hijri Date Conversion
endpoints.description: Converts a Gregorian date (DD-MM-YYYY) into its exact Hijri calendar counterpart.

endpoints.name: Hijri to Gregorian Date Conversion
endpoints.description: Converts a Hijri date (DD-MM-YYYY) into its Gregorian calendar equivalent.

endpoints.name: Qibla Direction
endpoints.description: Returns the Qibla compass bearing clockwise in degrees from True North.

endpoints.name: Get Calculation Methods
endpoints.description: Lists all official calculation methods and their detailed parameter settings.

endpoints.name: Get 99 Names of Allah
endpoints.description: Returns all 99 Names of Allah with transliteration, Arabic text, and English translation.
